audit.whatIsWrong: Three rows disagree with the mirror and the packet. Content has Skill at Level 3 and Level 6 and Darius at two items; the full layer has Skill at Level 3 and Level 6 and Darius at two items. The settled chart, from both the packet and the already-audited mirror, is Darius / Darius / Darius / Darius / Darius / Darius / Garen. Worse, every phases[].why in the full layer is Garen-favoured boilerplate sitting on rows marked Darius.
audit.why: The whys told the reader they win the level-1 chip war, get a free trade buffer at 2 and chunk him at 4-5 — on a chart that concedes all six of those stages. mirror-fix.js would overwrite the side fields and leave the contradicting prose in place.
audit.corrected: Chart proposed as one group to match the mirror, and phases[0], [1], [3] and [5] why-text rewritten to argue for Darius on their own rows with real numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Apprehend is the ability the entire page tells you to track, and its cooldown appears nowhere. It is 26/23.5/21/18.5/16 — 26 seconds at rank 1.
audit.why: 'Engage on Apprehend's cooldown' is unusable advice without the number. 26 seconds at rank 1 is an enormous window and it is the reason the early levels are survivable at all.
audit.corrected: 26s at rank 1 written into whys[2], spikes[0], phases[3].why and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two interactions were missing and one was vague. Noxian Guillotine deals TRUE damage scaled by Hemorrhage stacks and refreshes its cooldown on a kill — the page called it a 'resetting execute' without ever saying resistances do not apply. Decimate heals him off champions hit by the blade, and no anti-heal instruction existed. Crippling Strike is a 5s auto-attack reset, never mentioned, so the reader watches for an ability cast instead of the auto wind-up.
audit.why: All three change behaviour: stack health rather than armour against the ultimate, buy Grievous Wounds early against the blade heal, and read the auto-reset wind-up as the cue to disengage.
audit.corrected: True damage and the kill refresh in whys[4], spikes[1] and phases[5].why; Grievous Wounds and the blade heal in mid; the Crippling Strike wind-up tell in spikes[0].

edits.before: Your Q poke + passive regen win the level-1 chip war. Tag him on his last-hits and let Perseverance refill you for free.
edits.after: Darius out-stats you at 1 and Decimate's outer blade heals him. Tag him on his last-hits only, then break contact and regen.

edits.before: W gives you a trade buffer: Q in, take the answer on damage reduction, walk out and regen. Darius can't match the reset.
edits.after: Crippling Strike is a 5s auto reset that slows — the wind-up is your cue to leave, not to answer. Trade only with W up.

edits.before: Villain procs + spin ticks chunk hard now. Track Apprehend; your run-down only works when it can't answer.
edits.after: Apprehend is 26s at rank 1 — that gap is your only window. Step up once it is spent, never before.

edits.before: Stridebreaker turns your Q-MS run-down lethal — no more flip turns at the last second. Force fights on Apprehend's cooldown.
edits.after: Stridebreaker helps, but Noxian Guillotine is true damage and refreshes on a kill — armour does not answer it. Stay above the bleed.

edits.before: Level 3 his E pull cancels your Q flee, so trades favour him.
edits.after: At 3 Apprehend, 26s at rank 1, yanks you back mid-spin.

edits.before: Level 6 his resetting R Guillotine execute dominates the all-in.
edits.after: At 6 Noxian Guillotine is true damage and refreshes on a kill.

edits.before: Darius bullies you all through the early levels - his Q outer-edge heal and Apprehend (E) pull mean any spin you commit to gets punished with a stack of Hemorrhage bleed and a reset.
edits.after: Darius bullies the early levels — Decimate's blade heals him and Apprehend, 26s at rank 1, drags you back into any spin. Crippling Strike's wind-up is the tell to leave, not the cast.

edits.before: His R Noxian Guillotine is a resetting execute; once he has five bleed stacks you can be deleted, and you have no way to out-burst that from a position of disadvantage.
edits.after: Noxian Guillotine deals true damage that scales with Hemorrhage stacks and refreshes its cooldown on a kill — armour never answers it, so keep your bar above five stacks.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 stay bad. His trade pattern and R execute out-damage anything you can do while behind, so play for cooldowns: only step up to spin when his Q and E are both down, and back off the instant he closes. Never let your HP drop into his five-stack Guillotine range.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 stay bad. Play for cooldowns: step up only once Decimate and Apprehend are both spent — 26s on the pull at rank 1 — and back off the instant he closes. Buy Grievous Wounds early, since Decimate's blade heals him off you, and never sit inside five-stack Guillotine range.

notes: Stage ownership now matches the mirror exactly (Darius through first item, Garen at two items). The full layer's phases[].why text was the hidden problem here: it was generic Garen-wins-lane boilerplate pasted onto rows the chart concedes to Darius, so four of them are rewritten to argue their own side. As the mirror also noted, breakdown.wave and report[4].t still carry PDF-extraction artefacts and need a dedicated cleanup pass — I left them rather than risk a mismatched rewrite of an oversized block.
